name: Island Explorer
description: Discover Mauritius with small-group tours: lagoons, mountains, waterfalls and street food — with hotel pick-up included.

promises.title: Small groups
promises.text: Never more than 12 guests, so every tour feels personal.

promises.title: Hotel pick-up
promises.text: Door-to-door transfers from most hotels on the island.

promises.title: Safety first
promises.text: Licensed boats, first-aid trained guides and life jackets for everyone.

promises.title: Respect for nature
promises.text: We follow marine guidelines and keep to marked trails.

steps.title: Choose your tour
steps.text: Pick a date and the number of guests.

steps.title: Send a request
steps.text: We confirm availability within a few hours.

steps.title: Enjoy the island
steps.text: We pick you up at your hotel — just bring sunscreen.

faqs.a: Yes, from most hotels in the north, west and east. We confirm the pick-up time the day before.

faqs.q: What if the weather is bad?
faqs.a: Sea tours depend on the weather. If we cancel, you can move to another date or get a full refund.
